name: seif-mcp
stderr:
seif-mcp: 'seif' not found on PATH.

This Node package is a thin wrapper. The actual MCP server is the
Python 'seif' CLI from PyPI. Install it once with:

    pip install 'seif-cli[mcp]'

Then re-run this command. If 'seif' lives in a non-standard location,
set SEIF_PYTHON_COMMAND to its absolute path (e.g. ~/.local/bin/seif).
